criteria.behavior: First-run guidance uses real capability, permission and readiness state.
criteria.check: Run scripts/verification-lane.sh p10 after M1 implements it; inspect permission/capability matrix, UX tests and contract-review.md.
criteria.expected: Nonempty suites distinguish missing/revoked permission, resource/key/network failure and actual ready. No unavailable command is suggested as working; supported platform guidance is reused.

criteria.behavior: Three real first-use moments complete within the declared three-minute setup budget.
criteria.check: Inspect .agent/results/P10/qualification.json, signed artifact, event times and human evidence for read emails, look/open and add an event.
criteria.expected: All three actual outcomes <=3min from declared first launch, with account preconditions and permission time visible. No seeded completed-onboarding flags or canned result.

criteria.behavior: Acknowledgment, progress, terminal status and errors accurately reflect the executor.
criteria.check: Inspect normal-product integration records and UX/result tests for slow work, rejected/uncertain results, already-satisfied state and missing setup.
criteria.expected: Required ack <=300ms and S-FEEDBACK measured separately; no premature Done. Errors identify a usable remedy and the app stays responsive.

criteria.behavior: Read-back, cancellation and supported undo stay bound to the actual task and effect.
criteria.check: Run p10 cases and inspect integration.json for changed target/content, canceled approval, interrupted task and reversal on an unchanged versus changed target.
criteria.expected: No consent bypass or late input; undo is offered only for supported reversals and cannot affect unrelated work.

criteria.behavior: Feedback, diagnostics and tester metrics are local/redacted, and the real UI is usable.
criteria.check: Inspect feedback/metric storage, redaction cases and actual light/dark/accessibility screenshots in P10 evidence.
criteria.expected: No credentials/private content leak or unapproved external analytics; feedback links to the correct task and UI states remain readable and actionable.

criteria.behavior: Actual human first-use evidence and independent review close the onboarding phase.
criteria.check: Inspect G6 checklist, source/final verdicts, integrated checks, exact candidate identities and P10 handoff.
criteria.expected: Authorized independent PASS with no unresolved finding; actual Fn/pill/gaze behavior is demonstrated rather than inferred from typed or unit tests.
